source_excerpt.text: /// Default is the physical core count (<see cref="PhysicalCoreCount"/>, the logical count when it cannot be
/// detected), as PyTorch and OpenMP default to; the <c>AIDOTNET_CPU_THREADS</c> environment variable overrides it.
public static int MaxDegreeOfParallelism { get; set; } = DefaultDegreeOfParallelism();
return physical > 0 && physical <= Environment.ProcessorCount ? physical : Environment.ProcessorCount;

observations: DefaultDegreeOfParallelism uses detected physical cores unless explicitly overridden; trace batch limit2 matches its2physical cores.
SharedPointwiseBenchmarks.Setup explicitly sets MaxDegreeOfParallelism=8; captured kernel WorkerCount additionally caps by logical Environment.ProcessorCount.
Opposite profile outcomes reproduced; differing policy/workload/hardware contexts are not interchangeable. No benchmark workload or runtime settings changed.
limitations: Evidence supports a dispatch-topology hypothesis; it does not qualify any new source.
Replay sample attribution is wall/thread time and can include waiting and PowerShell overhead; PollGC samples do not prove equivalent GC pause duration.
Trace workers eventually reached Tier1; this does not establish BDN measurement-phase JIT timing.
